one_line: State the parent's reason in the first line while the box is being opened with the child.

q1_hook.what: 0:00 a mother and a boy about 4 kneel on a living-room floor opening a bike box before a pale sofa. Voiceover (transcript): "בתור אימא היה לי חשוב למצוא לילד שלי משהו שיעזור לו ללמוד לרכוב", subtitled from 0:00.
q1_hook.why: The box is being opened and a voice states a parent's goal at once (S1, H1, H4), subtitled word by word (H6). But it is a long wide shot with no cut until 0:20 and the first line is a flat statement, not a question or a promise (E1, H5, T3).

beats.what: Mother and boy unpack the bike box on the floor; the parent's goal is subtitled
beats.why: A real unboxing with a stated reason

beats.what: They read the manual; "אז הכרנו את Wheely מבית פלפוט"
beats.why: Names the brand once, in the story

beats.what: Together they bolt on the handlebar and wheels; "אופני איזון דגם Ride"
beats.why: Shows that the child can help build it

beats.what: He sits on the built bike; claims over it: no pedals, balance, strength; high-five at 0:19
beats.why: A small win with the claims on screen

beats.what: Close-ups of the bike, "RIDE" on the frame; hands adjust the seat
beats.why: A new angle for the "light and easy" claim

beats.what: Outdoors the boy sits on the bike on a path, looking at the lens; the closing line
beats.why: The bike in its real place of use

q2_flow.interaction_prompts: None. No question, save, share or tag ask in the video. The caption has hashtags and a brand tag only.
q2_flow.why: A small story (box, build, high-five, outdoors) gives a clear arc (K2), and the 0:19 high-five is the warm peak (K1). But 0:00 to 0:19 is one unbroken wide take with claims said over it (R1, R3), and the outdoor payoff gets only 5 s and no clear ride (R4).

q3_cta.what: None in the video: it ends on the line "לראות אותם מגלים בעצמם כמה הם מסוגלים" over the boy. Caption: a brand line ("עם Wheely -לומדים, מתנסים ונהנים"), 5 hashtags, @palphot. No link, price or ask.
q3_cta.why: A viewer who wants the bike gets no price, link or next step (C6). It stays clear of bait (C1, C2), but a parent-to-parent question or a send ask is also missing (C4, C5).

q4_shown.what: The box being opened at 0:00; assembly with a boy about 4; the boy on the built bike at 0:12; close-ups of the frame and "RIDE" at 0:20; the seat adjusted at 0:23; the boy on the bike outdoors at 0:26. No price.
q4_shown.why: The unboxing and build are in real time, from a mother's own voice (S1, S6). The claims of balance, strength and an easier move to a regular bike are said, but a ride is never shown (R3). The child's face and, in the caption, his name are what S5 warns about.

q5_edit.what: About 7 shots in 31 s (first pass), about 4.5 s each: a first cut at 0:01, one wide take to 0:19, then close-ups and two outdoor shots. No speed changes seen. Word-by-word subtitles follow the voiceover. Ends on a held outdoor shot.
q5_edit.why: A single real-time assembly take shows the build without cuts but has little pace for 19 s (E2, R1). Subtitles follow the voice, so it works muted (E4, T1). After 0:20 the cuts speed up and it ends cleanly (R3, E8).

q6_topic.what: A mother and her son unbox and assemble a first balance bike; it serves parents choosing how to help a child learn to ride.
q6_topic.why: Helping a child learn to ride is a real parent concern told in her own words (K6), and an unboxing with a child is a warm small moment (K1). Developmental claims such as strength and confidence are stated flatly with no source (K4). No gift or occasion is named (K7).

q7_filmed.what: A propped phone, static wide at about chest height, living-room floor, daylight, mother and boy seen from the side, a sofa behind. Then low close-ups of the bike, a handheld shot on hands, and handheld outdoor shots.
q7_filmed.why: A propped phone and a real home look native (H8, F7), but the bike is small in the wide frame for 19 s and the mother never looks at the lens (F4, F6). Close-ups after 0:20 fill the frame (F4).

q8_text.on_screen: White word-by-word subtitles, 1 to 2 lines, no box, about 73% down the frame over the sofa and the bike: 0:02 "היה לי חשוב למצוא לילד שלי", 0:07 "אז הכרנו את Wheely מבית פלפוט", 0:08 "אופני איזון דגם Ride", 0:12 "בלי דוושות ובלי גלגלי עזר", 0:24 "ואפשר פשוט לצאת איתם לרכיבה בכל מקום". No headline card.
q8_text.caption: "[the child's name] מגלה את עולם הרכיבה 🚲". About 20 words: a brand line, 5 hashtags (#kids, #fyp, #אמהות, #boy, #ישראל), @palphot. No CTA, no disclosure.
q8_text.why: Subtitles carry the message with sound off (T1, E4) but sit in the lower band over the product, in thin white over a pale sofa (T4, F2, T5). The caption's hashtags are generic, three in English (T7). The Palphot partnership is not disclosed in words (T8, S7).

weak_points: No CTA, price or where to buy; 19 s of one wide shot; claims said but not shown; the child's face and name; subtitles over the product; generic English hashtags; no disclosure of the Palphot collaboration.
lumebook_takeaway: Prop the phone on a stand, film opening the parcel with a hands-only close-up, say the parent's reason in one line, and add the ask this Reel lacks.
not_verified: Whether the woman is the account owner and whether the boy is her child; music (not established); whether the boy rides on the path (he sits or rolls slowly, no clear ride); the first subtitle reads "בתוך" at 0:00 where the voice says "בתור". The boy is about 4 (judged by eye). Cut count from the first pass. Lead edit 18 Oct: resolution remarks removed, because the downloaded copy can be smaller than what was posted.
